item.title: Qatar and Canada sign investment protection deal at first strategic dialogue
item.description:
Qatar and Canada signed an agreement on the promotion and protection of investments at their first strategic dialogue in Ottawa, according to a joint statement released on Friday. The dialogue on 24 November was chaired by Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani and Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand. The statement said bilateral trade in goods exceeded C$355 million in 2025, and both sides backed the two-state solution and rejected any annexation of the West Bank.

item.title: More than 1,000 startups confirm attendance at Web Summit Qatar 2027
item.description:
More than 1,000 startups and over 370 investors have confirmed attendance at the fourth Web Summit Qatar in 2027, the permanent organising committee said on Friday. The committee, chaired by Government Communications Office Director Sheikh Jassim bin Mansour bin Jabor Al Thani, said more than 120 partnerships have been signed, including first-time partners Visa and Hewlett Packard Enterprise. The number of registered media professionals has tripled compared with the same period last year.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/growing-international-interest-in-web-summit-qatar-2027 · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/27/%D8%A5%D9%82%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%B2%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%82%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A8-%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-2027

item.title: Kahramaa signs contracts worth over QR3bn to upgrade networks
item.description:
The Qatar General Electricity and Water Corporation (Kahramaa) signed contracts worth more than QR3 billion for strategic projects to develop electricity and water network infrastructure on Thursday in Doha. The projects will be carried out by 10 companies, five national and five international. Kahramaa said the contracts aim to prepare its networks for urban expansion, particularly land allocated to citizens.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266625/latest-news/kahramaa-signs-over-qr3-bn-strategic-contracts-to-develop-electricity-water-networks · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/27/%D8%B9%D9%82%D9%88%D8%AF-%D8%A8-3-%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B7%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%B4%D8%A8%D9%83%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%A1

item.title: Antonelli tops first practice for the Qatar Grand Prix at Lusail
item.description:
World champion Kimi Antonelli of Mercedes topped the first practice session for the Formula 1 Qatar Grand Prix at Lusail International Circuit on Friday. Antonelli was about half a second ahead of teammate George Russell, with Isack Hadjar third for Red Bull, Lando Norris fourth and Max Verstappen sixth. Lusail is the penultimate round of the 2026 season, and second practice follows this evening.
Sources: PlanetF1 https://www.planetf1.com/news/f1-results-qatar-grand-prix-2026-fp1 · The Race https://www.the-race.com/formula-1/f1-2026-qatar-grand-prix-practice-results/ · Motorsport Week https://www.motorsportweek.com/2026/11/27/f1-2026-qatar-grand-prix-fp1-results/

item.title: Interior ministry auctions boats online through the Sooum app
item.description:
The General Directorate of Coasts and Border Security at the Ministry of Interior announced an online boat auction through the Sooum app, opening at 7am on Tuesday 1 December and closing at 11am on Thursday 3 December. Boats can be inspected at the directorate headquarters in Al Daayen on 29 and 30 November from 7am to noon, and on the app around the clock. Bidders must pay a security deposit before bidding.

item.title: Al Sadd host Al Wakrah on Saturday in Stars League round 11
item.description:
Al Sadd and Al Wakrah meet on Saturday in round 11 of the Doha Bank Stars League. Al Sadd are second on 24 points, ahead of Al Duhail on goal difference, while Al Wakrah are ninth on 11 points after two successive defeats. Al Sadd coach Razvan Lucescu said the match demands concentration and discipline, while Al Wakrah coach Jose Luis Sierra said his team aims to bounce back from the defeat to Al Sailiya.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/doha-bank-stars-league-al-sadd-al-wakrah-target-victory · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/27/%D9%85%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%AF-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D9%83%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%A4%D9%83%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A3%D9%87%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B2

item.title: Attack on Saudi Jazan refinery kills worker and halts some operations
item.description:
A Nepali worker was killed and others of various nationalities were injured when an aerial projectile hit an oil refinery in Jazan, the Saudi Ministry of Energy said on Thursday evening. The ministry said the attack caused a fire, since brought under control, and temporarily halted some refinery operations. The coalition blamed the Houthi group; Qatar condemned the attack in the strongest terms on Friday, as did Kuwait, both affirming full solidarity with Saudi Arabia.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/attack-on-saudi-aramcos-jazan-refinery-kills-worker-disrupts-operations · The Peninsula (SPA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/27/11/2026/saudi-energy-ministry-one-dead-several-injured-in-attack-on-jazan-refinery · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266804/latest-news/qatar-strongly-condemns-houthi-attack-on-jazan-refinery-in-saudi-arabia · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/kuwait-condemns-continued-houthi-attacks-on-saudi-arabia

item.title: Coalition intercepts Houthi drone launched towards Riyadh region
item.description:
The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen intercepted and destroyed a drone launched by the Houthi group towards the Riyadh region on Friday, its spokesman Major General Turki Al Maliki said. The interception came a day after an attack hit the Jazan refinery, and after the Houthis claimed attacks on Ras Tanura and the ports of Jeddah and Jazan.

item.title: Revolutionary Guards say tanker hit a mine in Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
The Iranian Revolutionary Guards navy said on Friday that a tanker exploded after striking a mine while trying to cross the Strait of Hormuz through what it called an unauthorised route, in a statement carried by state broadcaster IRIB. Iranian Navy commander Shahram Irani said his forces had recovered two tankers he said had been seized by the US military, without saying when. There was no US comment.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/27/iran-war-live-irans-araghchi-calls-deadly-kuwait-attack-suspicious · Oman Observer (Reuters) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200288/world/region/tanker-hits-mine-near-strait-of-hormuz · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-tensions-trump-signals-victory-as-iran-offers-kuwait-drone-probe-1.500762639

item.title: Iran denies Kuwait drone attack as Britain condemns it
item.description:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi denied any Iranian role in Thursday's drone attack on Kuwait that killed two Italians, after Kuwaiti and Italian officials blamed Iran. Britain condemned the attacks as "reckless" and "utterly unacceptable", and Saudi Arabia condemned what it called "Iranian aggression" against Kuwait. It was the first deadly attack on Kuwait in several months.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200289/world/region/rheinmetall-grieving-for-employees-killed-in-kuwait-attack · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-tensions-trump-signals-victory-as-iran-offers-kuwait-drone-probe-1.500762639 · Kuwait Times (KUNA) https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54466/kuwait/uk-condemns-reckless-drone-attacks-on-kuwait-as-unacceptable/

item.title: Kuwait arrests ruling family member in drugs case
item.description:
Kuwait's General Department for Drug Control arrested two people, one of them a member of the ruling family, in possession of narcotics and psychotropic substances, the Interior Ministry said on Friday. Seizures included 1.2 kilograms of hashish, 262 Lyrica capsules, 100 Xanax tablets and four precision scales. The ministry said the suspects would be referred to the drugs prosecution, stressing that "no one is above the law".

item.title: UAE launches nine tech partnerships to train 80,000 government staff
item.description:
The UAE government launched strategic partnerships with nine technology companies to build agentic AI expertise among federal employees, in the presence of Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan on Friday. The partners include Etisalat, Microsoft, Google Cloud, Oracle and Amazon Web Services, under a programme to train more than 80,000 employees. The government aims to move 50% of its operations and services to agentic AI models within two years.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/uae-launches-strategic-technology-partnerships-to-equip-over-80000-government-employees-with-agentic-ai-skills-1.500763153 · Emirates 24|7 https://www.emirates247.com/uae/in-presence-of-mansour-bin-zayed-uae-government-launches-partnerships-to-build-agentic-ai-expertise-across-federal-government/8218

item.title: flydubai extends Riyadh flight cancellations to 10 December
item.description:
flydubai has extended cancellations of flights to and from Riyadh until 10 December, and Abha flights until the end of the month, a spokesperson said on Friday. Dammam flights are operating on a reduced schedule. The airline said it is monitoring the situation closely and advised passengers to check their flight status and update their contact details.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/aviation/flydubai-updates-saudi-flights-amid-regional-disruption-1.500762971 · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/flydubai-extends-riyadh-and-abha-flight-cancellations-until-december

item.title: Ras Al Khaimah reopens all hotel beaches after oil spill cleanup
item.description:
Ras Al Khaimah has reopened all hotel beaches in the emirate after precautionary closures over an oil spill, the Public Services Department said on Friday. The emirate closed its beaches on 24 October after the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment confirmed a spill from a tanker off Umm Al Quwain. The department urged beachgoers to follow the authorities' instructions.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/ras-al-khaimah/uae-oil-spill-cleanup-ras-al-khaimah-reopens-all-hotel-beaches-after-temporary-closures-1.500763067 · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/ras-al-khaimah-reopens-hotel-beaches-after-temporary-closures-due-to-oil-spill

item.title: Health ministry identifies 27 victims of Warraq ring road fire
item.description:
The Ministry of Health and Population said on Friday it had identified 27 victims of the fuel tanker fire on the ring road in Warraq through DNA tests and begun issuing burial permits. Forensic doctors took samples from the driver accused of causing the crash to test for drugs, after prosecutors ordered him held for four days. The fire on Wednesday evening killed 31 people.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/27/3085380 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7196622 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/x/7633738 · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/26/egypt-detains-driver-over-cairo-fuel-tanker-fire-that-killed-31

item.title: Donations for Warraq victims' families exceed EGP240mn in one day
item.description:
Contributions to support the families of victims and injured in the Warraq accident exceeded EGP240 million on Thursday, cabinet spokesman Mohamed Adel said. On Friday he announced two new donations totalling EGP25 million, EGP15 million from Mansour Group and EGP10 million from the chairman of Amea Power. The government and the social solidarity ministry are setting mechanisms to pay compensation to those eligible.
Sources: Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7196636 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/x/7634061

item.title: Gold rises about EGP160 with 21-carat near EGP5,810
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt rose by about EGP160 a gram on Friday compared with Thursday. The popular 21-carat grade stood at EGP5,790 at midday according to Masrawy, then EGP5,810 for buying in the evening according to Sada El Balad. 24-carat gold reached about EGP6,640 and the gold pound about EGP46.48 thousand in the evening.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/27/3085279 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7196655

item.title: Dollar steady at EGP54.77 buying rate in major banks
item.description:
The dollar was steady at Egyptian banks on Friday, a banking holiday, at EGP54.77 for buying and EGP54.87 for selling at National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr and CIB. The lowest buying rate was EGP54.67 at Bank of Alexandria and the highest EGP54.85 at Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank.
Sources: Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7196678 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/x/7634040

item.title: Zamalek and Pyramids open African Champions League groups on Saturday
item.description:
Zamalek and Pyramids begin their African Champions League group campaigns on Saturday 28 November at 6pm Cairo time (7pm Doha time). Zamalek host Club Africain at Cairo International Stadium before 42,000 fans, while Pyramids face Maghreb de Fes. CAF approved a minute's silence before Zamalek's match for the victims of the Warraq accident.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/sports/sports_news/details/2026/11/27/3085245 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7196651

item.title: Trump offers Iran a chance at a deal and keeps troops in region
item.description:
US President Donald Trump said Washington was trying "to be flexible" and give Iran a chance to reach a deal to save lives, while US forces remain in the Middle East, in Thanksgiving remarks at his Mar-a-Lago resort on Thursday. In a phone call he praised troops deployed at Al Dhafra air base in the UAE and Prince Sultan air base in Saudi Arabia, and played down Russian and Chinese support for Tehran.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/trump-downplays-russia-china-support-for-iran-during-talks-with-us-troops · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266803/latest-news/we-are-seeking-agreement-with-iran-our-forces-will-continue-deployment-in-middle-east-trump

item.title: Luxon coalition loses majority in New Zealand final election results
item.description:
New Zealand's ruling coalition led by Prime Minister Christopher Luxon lost its parliamentary majority by one seat in the final results of the 7 November election, released on Friday. National and its partners ACT and New Zealand First won 65 of 130 seats, the same number as the opposition parties and Opportunity combined. That leaves the centrist party as kingmaker, with recounts still possible in some electorates.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/new-zealand-election-results-set-up-tricky-talks-for-conservative-incumbent · RNZ https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/politics_election-2026/2820329/election-2026-final-results-coalition-loses-majority-another-election-possible

item.title: French economy contracts 0.2% in third quarter after revision
item.description:
France's gross domestic product contracted 0.2% in the third quarter of 2026, revised from a preliminary estimate of 0.1%, the national statistics institute INSEE said on Friday. Exports fell 1.6% while household consumption rose 0.3%. Meeting the government's 0.5% annual growth target would require 1.4% growth in the final quarter.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/french-gdp-contracts-in-q3-of-2026 · Xinhua https://english.news.cn/europe/20261127/103b36e40bf04a6ca3f6277b0ea07355/c.html

item.title: Argentina bans central bank from printing money to fund government
item.description:
Argentina's Chamber of Deputies on Thursday passed a law barring the central bank from printing money to fund government spending, defining its primary mission as preserving the value of the peso. The bill passed 141-0 with 99 abstentions, a victory for President Javier Milei. It comes days after preliminary figures suggested the country had slipped into recession.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/argentina-bars-central-bank-from-printing-money-to-fund-government-spending · KIRO 7 (AP) https://www.kiro7.com/news/business/argentina-bans-its/BHIUVIWJSA3M7IHLIY5NK26NYY/

item.title: UN warns hunger will worsen in 16 hotspots through May 2027
item.description:
The FAO and the World Food Programme warned on Friday that acute food insecurity will worsen in 16 hotspots between December 2026 and May 2027, up from 13 in June. Sudan, Yemen, South Sudan, Somalia and parts of Nigeria are of highest concern, with a risk of famine in parts of Sudan and South Sudan. El Nino added Southern Africa and the Central American Dry Corridor to the list.
Sources: World Food Programme https://www.wfp.org/news/el-nino-adds-new-hunger-hotspots-conflict-continues-drive-risk-famine-warn-fao-and-wfp · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/un-warns-hunger-crisis-will-deepen-as-war-fuel-costs-and-aid-cuts-hit-middle-east-1.500763304

item.title: Macron condemns Marseille fan violence as five Bulgarian fans hospitalised
item.description:
French President Emmanuel Macron condemned "in the strongest possible terms" violence targeting Levski Sofia supporters before their Europa League match at Olympique de Marseille on Thursday evening. Five Bulgarian fans were taken to hospital after clashes in the stands involving projectiles and flares. Macron spoke to the Bulgarian leadership about the incident.
